verdict.rationale: Grok offers connectors (Gmail, Drive, Teams, Salesforce, custom MCP) and a 'Grok Bot' that operates on a persistent *cloud* computer, but there is no evidence of Grok seeing or controlling applications running on the user's own local machine/desktop (e.g., screen/GUI control akin to computer-use agents). Missing for 10: any documented local-computer screen/GUI control, first-party or hands-on evidence of operating a user's own desktop apps.
